findings.title: Working tree leaks personal identity into shared config
findings.problem: activeProfile, profile key/name and codeMieProject were changed from 'epm-cdme' to the developer's personal identity 'dzmitry_halai@epam.com', unrelated to the EPMCDME-16647 OTLP fix.
findings.impact: Commits a developer's personal identity into a shared tracked config file and silently reassigns the default profile for anyone who pulls it, repeating an incident already reverted once (68fd2e4).
findings.recommendation: Revert .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json to restore the 'epm-cdme' profile, key, name and codeMieProject; exclude local profile switches from this changeset.

findings.title: Pre-spawn OTLP refresh has no timeout guard
findings.problem: The new pre-spawn `ensureOtlpProxy('claude-code-otlp')` call in beforeRun (lines 587-596) is awaited with no timeout, unlike the backgroundable SessionStart hook path it supplements; its internals can run SSO credential checks and spawn/health-check a daemon.
findings.impact: A slow SSO or daemon health check now stalls the synchronous pre-spawn path of every already-connected Claude/claude-acp launch indefinitely, where the same logic previously only ran in the backgroundable hook after the session had already started.
findings.recommendation: Bound the pre-spawn call with a timeout (e.g. Promise.race against a short deadline) so a slow credential/daemon check degrades to relying on the existing hook-time rewrite instead of stalling the launch.
findings.check_notes: beforeRun now wraps ensureOtlpProxy in withTimeout(..., PRE_SPAWN_OTLP_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS=3000, ...); a timeout rejects into the existing catch/logger.warn non-blocking path.

fix.change: Wrapped the pre-spawn ensureOtlpProxy() call in claude.plugin.ts beforeRun with a 3s Promise.race timeout (withTimeout helper); a timeout is caught by the existing non-blocking catch block.
fix.test: src/agents/plugins/claude/__tests__/claude.plugin.otlp-preflight.test.ts > 'does not stall the launch when the refresh never settles'

findings.title: Hardcoded OTLP clientType mislabels claude-acp
findings.problem: beforeRun passes the literal string 'claude-code-otlp' (the OTLP hook adapter's own name) as the agentName/clientType argument to ensureOtlpProxy, instead of this.metadata.name ('claude' or 'claude-acp'); claude-acp.plugin.ts inherits this same beforeRun via its metadata spread.
findings.impact: When ensureOtlpProxy cold-starts without an existing clientType on the connection record, the daemon/connection record is tagged with clientType 'claude-code-otlp' instead of the real launching client, mislabeling analytics/telemetry attribution for claude-acp sessions in particular.
findings.recommendation: Pass this.metadata.name instead of the literal 'claude-code-otlp' to ensureOtlpProxy.
findings.check_notes: beforeRun is now typed `this: BaseAgentAdapter` and calls ensureOtlpProxy(this.metadata.name) instead of the literal 'claude-code-otlp'; new tests assert 'claude' and 'claude-acp' attribution.

fix.change: Replaced the hardcoded 'claude-code-otlp' clientType argument to ensureOtlpProxy() with this.metadata.name (typed via `this: BaseAgentAdapter` on beforeRun), so claude-acp launches attribute correctly instead of inheriting claude's literal.
fix.test: src/agents/plugins/claude/__tests__/claude.plugin.otlp-preflight.test.ts > 'refreshes the OTLP endpoint before spawn when already connected' and > 'attributes a claude-acp launch as claude-acp, not claude-code-otlp or claude'

final_round.rationale: The edge-case and acceptance lenses and the standards audit all ran cleanly with no coverage gap; acceptance found every AC/approach/non-goal satisfied, but the standards audit flagged a critical, task-unrelated identity leak in .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json (CR-001, repeats a previously reverted incident), and the edge-case lens surfaced two real defects in the new pre-spawn OTLP block: a hardcoded clientType mislabeling claude-acp sessions (CR-003) and an unbounded await that can stall every connected launch (CR-002). One edge-case candidate (the un-try/catch'd isClaudeCodeOtlpConnected call) was dismissed as noise since its only callee already swallows all errors internally; nothing was deferred and no item needs a human decision.
